lines.text: Because your feed works like a machine.
Most posts are okay. Then one is great.
You never know which swipe pays off.
Slot machines run on the same idea.
No last page means no natural place to stop.
A little number that says something is waiting.
The next one starts before you decide.
So it's not just you. It's design.
Which means you can design the stop back in.
Turn off badges. Pick an end point first.
Now the machine has an off switch.
